title: Image and inverse-image identities of the filtered cycle class map
statement: Let C be an abelian category, K a cochain complex and L a decreasing filtration. For integers p,n set A=L.complexStep p n, A′=L.complexStep (p+1) n, Z=ker(K.d n (n+1)), B=im(K.d (n-1) n), and S=A∩Z. Let c:S→K.cycles n satisfy c followed by the cycle inclusion = S.arrow, and set f=c followed by K.homologyπ n. Then imageSubobject f=(L.cohomologyImage n).step p, and the inverse image under f of (L.cohomologyImage n).step (p+1) equals the restriction to S of (A∩B)+(A′∩Z).

source.place: Section 12.24, Equation 12.24.5.2 and the final quotient calculation of Lemma 12.24.6.

proof.text: The subcomplex inclusion identifies its cycles with A intersection Z by the pullback universal property. Naturality and epimorphy of the cycle-to-homology map identify the image of f with the cohomology image step. Repeat at p+1. The ambient cycle class epimorphism has kernel B; the inverse image of the next image step is B+(A′ intersection Z). Restrict to S and use the modular identity, B contained in Z and A′ contained in A, to get the displayed inverse-image formula.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomologyImage_cycle_map
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} (L : DecreasingFiltration K) (p n : ℤ)
    (c : ((L.complexStep p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥ :
      Subobject (K.X n)) : C) ⟶
      K.cycles n)
    (hc : c ≫ K.iCycles n =
      (L.complexStep p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥).arrow) :
  let A := L.complexStep p n
  let A' := L.complexStep (p + 1) n
  let Z := (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥
  let B := imageSubobject (K.d (n - 1) n)
  let f := c ≫ K.homologyπ n
  imageSubobject f = (L.cohomologyImage n).step p ∧
    (Subobject.pullback f).obj ((L.cohomologyImage n).step (p + 1)) =
      (Subobject.pullback (A ⊓ Z).arrow).obj ((A ⊓ B) ⊔ (A' ⊓ Z))
